capabilities: Parse pasted job postings into structured notes with deadline, salary, location and requirements
Track application statuses with a dated timeline and a board note showing due and stale items
Match resume bullets to posting requirements and suggest rewordings using a local model
Draft eight likely interview questions grounded in the posting
Export upcoming deadlines as an .ics calendar file
extras: Free and MIT licensed with no accounts, API keys or telemetry; without Ollama the regex parsing, board, status workflow and calendar export still work, only Tailor and Interview prep need the model.
problem: Tracking job applications usually means spreadsheets or cloud services; Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a pasted posting into a structured note with deadline, status and fit tracking.

relations.evidence: let a local model (via Ollama) point out which of your resume bullets answer which requirement

summary: Job application tracker that turns pasted postings into structured notes with a status board and uses a local model to tailor resumes and prep interviews.
